rationale: The stock is in a persistent intraday downtrend (price ~7.8% below session VWAP, 14.1% off the low, 2.83x relative volume on a second consecutive down day against a rising tape), which argues for shorts, but the entry location is poor: price is deeply stretched from VWAP, and the last five 5-minute candles show a tight, low-volume base at 24.57–24.64 with no breakdown of the 24.32 low and no pullback to resistance — so neither a continuation trigger nor a reversal trigger has fired. With no news to explain the decline (creating binary bounce risk) and roughly 1:1 reward-to-risk at the current price for either direction, the mechanical edge is insufficient to commit capital; I would need a pullback toward the 5-minute VWAP (~24.81) to short or a confirmed reclaim of it to go long.
